Title: Azure Maps Standard Transactions meter name changes

Body.Content:
Starting November 1, 2019, some meter names of Azure Maps Standard IP-to-country transactions and Standard S1 IP-to-country transactions will change.

This won’t affect pricing, but you’ll need to modify billing routines that rely on these meter names:
